Indian Astrophysicist Wins COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal

Professor Annapurni Subramaniam, an Indian astrophysicist, has been awarded the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal for 2026. She is recognized for her pioneering contributions to space research. Subramaniam is the first Indian woman scientist to receive this prestigious award.
